CustomField.description: Whether the target field's value comes from a field on the source record or from a hard-coded literal entered on this mapping. Defaults to "Source Field" so that mappings created before this field existed behave unchanged.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Choose "Source Field" to copy a value from the source record, or "Static Value" to always send the literal entered in Source Value.
CustomField.label: Mapping Type
